caption: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows beneath a generous mound of shredded cabbage and chopped green onions. Served in a white bowl with red trim, it rests on a dark surface under soft, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark, textured surface with subtle grain, oval shape, and slight sheen near edges.
The spicy broth is reddish-brown, glossy, and speckled with sesame seeds, swirling around noodles and toppings.
White ceramic bowl with red stripes, smooth surface, slightly raised rim, and faint speckles.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
